1 --- 2 name: infographic-creator 3 description: 基于给定文字内容创建精美信息图。当用户请求创建信息图时使用。 4 --- 5 6 信息图（Infographic）将数据、信息与知识转化为可感知的视觉语言。它结合视觉设计与数据可视化，用直观符号压缩复杂信息，帮助受众快速理解并记住要点。 7 8 `Infographic = Information Structure + Visual Expression` 9 10 本任务使用 [AntV Infographic](https://infographic.antv.vision/) 创建可视化信息图。 11 12 在开始任务前，需要理解 AntV Infographic 语法规范，包括模板列表、数据结构、主题等。 13 14 ## 规范 15 16 ### AntV Infographic 语法 17 18 AntV Infographic 语法是一种自定义 DSL，用于描述信息图渲染配置。它使用缩进表达结构，适合 AI 直接生成并流式输出。核心信息包括： 19 20 1. template：用模板表达信息结构。 21 2. data：信息图数据，包含 `title`、`desc` 和主数据字段。 22 3. theme：主题配置，包含 `palette`、字体、风格化等。 23 24 例如： 25 26 ```infographic 27 infographic list-row-horizontal-icon-arrow 28 data 29 title Title 30 desc Description 31 lists 32 - label Label 33 value 12.5 34 desc Explanation 35 icon document text 36 theme 37 palette #3b82f6 #8b5cf6 #f97316 38 ``` 39 40 ### 硬性语法规则 41 42 - 第一行必须是 `infographic `。 43 - 模板列表里只写模板名本身；真正输出时首行必须显式写出 `infographic` 前缀。 44 - 使用 `data` / `theme` 块，块内统一使用两个空格缩进。 45 - 键值对写法是 `键 空格 值`；对象数组使用 `-` 作为条目前缀。 46 - `icon` 使用图标关键词，例如 `star fill`、`mingcute/server-line`。 47 - `value` 尽量使用纯数值；数值单位优先放在 `label` 或 `desc` 中表达。 48 - `palette` 推荐使用行内简单数组写法，例如 `palette #4f46e5 #06b6d4 #10b981`。 49 - `palette` 中的颜色值是裸值，不加引号，不加逗号。 50 - `data` 只放一个与模板匹配的主数据字段，避免同时混用 `lists`、`sequences`、`compares`、`values`、`root`、`nodes`。 51 52 主数据字段选择规则： 53 54 - `list-*` → `lists` 55 - `sequence-*` → `sequences`，可选 `order asc|desc` 56 - `sequence-interaction-*` → `sequences` + `relations` 57 - `sequences` 表示泳道列表 58 - 每个泳道必须包含 `label` 59 - 每个泳道的 `children` 表示节点列表 60 - `children` 下的每一项都必须写成对象条目，并包含 `label` 61 - 节点可选 `id`、`icon`、`step`、`desc`、`value` 62 - `step` 用于表示时间层级；相同 `step` 处于同一高度 63 - `compare-*` → `compares` 64 - `compare-binary-*` / `compare-hierarchy-left-right-*` 65 - `compares` 第一层必须且只能有两个根节点，分别表示对比双方 66 - 两个根节点都应包含 `children` 67 - 真正的对比项写在各自的 `children` 下 68 - `children` 下的每一项都必须写成对象条目，并包含 `label` 69 - 即使每一侧只有 1 个指标，也要写成 `children` 内含 1 个对象条目 70 - `compare-swot` 71 - `compares` 可直接放多个根节点 72 - 每个根节点下可选 `children` 73 - `compare-quadrant-*` 74 - `compares` 直接放 4 个象限根节点 75 - `hierarchy-structure` → `items` 76 - `hierarchy-*` → 单一 `root`，通过 `children` 递归嵌套 77 - `relation-*` → `nodes` + `relations` 78 - 简单关系也可直接用箭头语法表达关系 79 - `chart-*` → `values` 80 - `chart-line-plain-text` / `chart-bar-plain-text` / `chart-column-simple` 都使用单条有序 `values` 81 - 每个数据点使用 `label` 表示类目，使用 `value` 表示数值 82 - 折线图的顺序由 `values` 中条目的排列顺序表达 83 - 结构无法明确判断时，再用 `items` 兜底 84 85 主题规则： 86 87 - `theme` 用于自定义主题，例如 `palette`、`base`、`stylize` 88 - 使用 `theme.base.text.font-family` 指定字体，如 `851tegakizatsu` 89 - 使用 `theme.stylize` 选择内置风格并传参 90 - `rough`：手绘效果 91 - `pattern`：图案填充 92 - `linear-gradient` / `radial-gradient`：渐变风格 93 - 仅输出 Infographic 语法本身，不输出 JSON、解释性文字或额外 Markdown 段落 94 95 ## 数据语法示例 96 97 按模板类别给出精简但完整的正向示例： 98 99 - `list-*` 模板 100 101 ```infographic 102 infographic list-grid-badge-card 103 data 104 title Feature List 105 lists 106 - label Fast 107 icon flash fast 108 - label Secure 109 icon shield check 110 ``` 111 112 - `sequence-*` 模板 113 114 ```infographic 115 infographic sequence-ascending-steps 116 data 117 title 发布流程 118 sequences 119 - label 需求确认 120 - label 开发实现 121 - label 发布上线 122 order asc 123 ``` 124 125 - `sequence-interaction-*` 模板 126 127 ```infographic 128 infographic sequence-interaction-compact-animated-badge-card 129 data 130 title 登录校验流程 131 sequences 132 - label 用户 133 children 134 - label 发起登录 135 id user-login 136 step 0 137 - 生成结果 -> server-return 151 server-return - 返回结果 -> user-result 152 ``` 153 154 - `hierarchy-*` 模板 155 156 ```infographic 157 infographic hierarchy-tree-curved-line-rounded-rect-node 158 data 159 title 组织结构 160 root 161 label 公司 162 children 163 - label 产品部 164 - label 技术部 165 ``` 166 167 - `compare-swot` 模板 168 169 ```infographic 170 infographic compare-swot 171 data 172 title 产品 SWOT 173 compares 174 - label Strengths 175 children 176 - label 品牌认知高 177 - 1	# Hunger Doesn't Wait — Together We Can End It
     2	
     3	## The Hunger Crisis in America
     4	
     5	Hunger is not a distant problem — it is a crisis unfolding in every community across the United States. Today, **48 million people** face hunger in the U.S., including **14 million children**. Families in every state, in urban and rural areas alike, struggle to put nutritious food on the table. This is not just a statistic — it represents neighbors, classmates, coworkers, and community members who need support right now.
     6	
     7	## The Power of a Nationwide Network
     8	
     9	Feeding America operates one of the nation's largest and most effective hunger-relief networks, moving food quickly, safely, and reliably to the communities that need it most. The results speak for themselves:
    10	
    11	| Metric | Impact |
    12	|---|---|
    13	| Meals Distributed | 5.7 billion |
    14	| Food Rescued | 4.3 billion pounds |
    15	| Free Food Programs | 60,000+ |
    16	| Food Banks in Network | 200+ |
    17	
    18	This vast infrastructure ensures that rescued food — perfectly good food that might otherwise go to waste — reaches people facing hunger across all 50 states and Puerto Rico.
    19	
    20	## How We Unite Communities
    21	
    22	The approach rests on four interconnected pillars:
    23	
    24	- **Research-Driven Insights**: Listening to neighbors facing hunger and sharing their stories and ideas. Their voices shape real solutions and guide the path toward an America without hunger.
    25	- **Local Relationships, National Impact**: Food bank leaders are passionate community members. Local wisdom is turned into national action every day.
    26	- **Nationwide Scale**: As one of the nation's most effective food networks, the system moves food quickly and reliably to where it is needed most.
    27	- **Nutrition for Every Plate**: Making nutritious food more accessible so everyone can lead fuller, healthier lives. As one participant shared: *"I have high blood pressure and high cholesterol and am on a budget. They give you groceries and recipes. I've learned how to use whole foods and learned different options."* — Kaycee, Washington
    28	
    29	## Every Action Counts
    30	
    31	Ending hunger requires collective effort. There are many ways to contribute:
    32	
    33	| Action | Why It Matters |
    34	|---|---|
    35	| **Donate** | Every $1 provides at least 10 meals to neighbors in need. Gifts are matched for a limited time to move fresh food to neighbors fast. |
    36	| **Advocate** | Urge lawmakers to support community organizations and government programs that help neighbors facing hunger. |
    37	| **Fundraise** | Inspire your community to come together and make a collective difference. |
    38	| **Volunteer** | Sorting, packing, and distributing food takes many hands — including yours. |
    39	
    40	## A Vision for the Future
    41	
    42	Hunger touches every U.S. community, but together, we can meet this moment. Food rescue cannot wait. When communities unite — through donations, advocacy, volunteering, and shared purpose — an America without hunger is within reach. The resolve to end hunger is stronger than ever.

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

# Canvas size - portrait poster (1200x1800 is a good high-res poster size)
W, H = 1200, 1800

# Color palette - deep warm tones
BG_DARK = (26, 15, 10)
BG_MID = (45, 20, 10)
ACCENT_ORANGE = (234, 88, 12)
ACCENT_RED = (194, 65, 12)
ACCENT_GOLD = (251, 191, 36)
ACCENT_LIGHT = (253, 230, 138)
TEXT_WHITE = (255, 248, 240)
TEXT_MUTED = (200, 180, 160)

# Load fonts
font_path_bold = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
font_path_regular = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"
font_path_dejavu_bold = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
font_path_dejavu = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"

def get_font(path, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

# Create canvas
img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), BG_DARK)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Helper: draw rounded rectangle
def rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = xy
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill)

# Helper: center text
def draw_text_centered(draw, text, y, font, fill, x_center=W//2):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text((x_center - tw//2, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

# Helper: left-aligned text
def draw_text_left(draw, text, xy, font, fill):
    draw.text(xy, text, font=font, fill=fill)

# Title section
font_title = get_font(font_path_bold, 72)
font_subtitle = get_font(font_path_regular, 32)
font_stat_num = get_font(font_path_bold, 120)
font_stat_label = get_font(font_path_regular, 28)
font_section_title = get_font(font_path_bold, 40)
font_body = get_font(font_path_regular, 24)
font_cta_title = get_font(font_path_bold, 32)
font_cta_desc = get_font(font_path_regular, 22)
font_footer = get_font(font_path_regular, 20)

y = 60

# Main headline
draw_text_centered(draw, "HUNGER DOESN'T WAIT", y, font_title, TEXT_WHITE)
y += 90
draw_text_centered(draw, "Together We Can End It", y, font_subtitle, ACCENT_GOLD)
y += 100

# Divider line
draw.line([(100, y), (W-100, y)], fill=ACCENT_ORANGE, width=3)
y += 60

# CRISIS STAT - 48 Million (visual anchor #1)
rounded_rect(draw, (80, y, W-80, y+220), 20, BG_MID)
draw_text_centered(draw, "48 MILLION", y+30, font_stat_num, ACCENT_ORANGE)
draw_text_centered(draw, "Americans face hunger — including 14 million children", y+170, font_stat_label, TEXT_MUTED)
y += 260

# IMPACT STAT - 5.7 Billion Meals (visual anchor #2)
rounded_rect(draw, (80, y, W-80, y+220), 20, BG_MID)
draw_text_centered(draw, "5.7 BILLION", y+30, font_stat_num, ACCENT_GOLD)
draw_text_centered(draw, "meals distributed through the Feeding America network", y+170, font_stat_label, TEXT_MUTED)
y += 260

# Divider line
draw.line([(100, y), (W-100, y)], fill=ACCENT_ORANGE, width=2)
y += 50

# Network impact stats (4 smaller stats in a 2x2 grid)
stat_font_num = get_font(font_path_bold, 48)
stat_font_label = get_font(font_path_regular, 20)

stats = [
    ("4.3B", "pounds of food rescued"),
    ("60,000+", "free food programs"),
    ("200+", "food banks nationwide"),
    ("50 states", "plus Puerto Rico"),
]

gap = 30
card_w = (W - 160 - gap) // 2
card_h = 110
for i, (num, label) in enumerate(stats):
    col = i % 2
    row = i // 2
    x = 80 + col * (card_w + gap)
    cy = y + row * (card_h + gap)
    rounded_rect(draw, (x, cy, x+card_w, cy+card_h), 15, BG_MID)
    draw_text_centered(draw, num, cy+15, stat_font_num, TEXT_WHITE, x+card_w//2)
    draw_text_centered(draw, label, cy+70, stat_font_label, TEXT_MUTED, x+card_w//2)

y += 2 * card_h + gap + 60

# Divider line

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import os

# Canvas size - portrait poster (high-res for print-quality)

ACCENT_ORANGE = (234, 88, 12)
ACCENT_RED = (194, 65, 12)
ACCENT_GOLD = (251, 191, 36)
ACCENT_LIGHT = (253, 230, 138)
TEXT_WHITE = (255, 248, 240)
TEXT_MUTED = (180, 160, 140)
CARD_BG = (55, 28, 16)

# Load fonts
font_path_bold = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
font_path_regular = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"

def get_font(path, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

# Create canvas with subtle gradient background
img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), BG_DARK)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Draw subtle radial gradient background
for y in range(H):
    for x in range(0, W, 4):
        # Distance from center
        dx = x - W//2
        dy = y - H//3
        dist = (dx*dx + dy*dy) ** 0.5
        intensity = max(0, 1 - dist / 1200)
        r = int(BG_DARK[0] + intensity * 18)
        g = int(BG_DARK[1] + intensity * 8)
        b = int(BG_DARK[2] + intensity * 5)
        draw.rectangle([(x, y), (x+3, y)], fill=(r, g, b))

# Helper functions
def draw_text_centered(draw, text, y, font, fill, x_center=W//2):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text((x_center - tw//2, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def draw_text_right(draw, text, xy, font, fill):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text((xy[0] - tw, xy[1]), text, font=font, fill=fill)

# Load font sizes
font_title = get_font(font_path_bold, 78)
font_subtitle = get_font(font_path_regular, 34)
font_stat_num = get_font(font_path_bold, 130)
font_stat_label = get_font(font_path_regular, 26)

font_body = get_font(font_path_regular, 24)

font_cta_desc = get_font(font_path_regular, 21)

font_small_label = get_font(font_path_regular, 19)

font_brand = get_font(font_path_bold, 20)

y += 95

draw.line([(W//2 + 20, y), (W-150, y)], fill=ACCENT_ORANGE, width=3)
y += 60

# ===== CRISIS STAT: 48 MILLION =====

card_top = y
card_bottom = y + 260
# Card background with border

# Large number

draw_text_centered(draw, "MILLION", card_top + 115, get_font(font_path_bold, 70), TEXT_WHITE)
draw_text_centered(draw, "Americans face hunger — including 14 million children", card_top + 200, font_stat_label, TEXT_MUTED)
y = card_bottom + 35

# ===== IMPACT STAT: 5.7 BILLION MEALS =====
card_top = y
card_bottom = y + 260
draw.rounded_rectangle([(card_margin, card_top), (W-card_margin, card_bottom)], radius=24, fill=CARD_BG, outline=ACCENT_GOLD, width=3)
draw_text_centered(draw, "5.7", card_top + 25, get_font(font_path_bold, 160), ACCENT_GOLD)
draw_text_centered(draw, "BILLION MEALS", card_top + 115, get_font(font_path_bold, 70), TEXT_WHITE)
draw_text_centered(draw, "distributed through the Feeding America network", card_top + 200, font_stat_label, TEXT_MUTED)
y = card_bottom + 50

y += 45

    ("4.3B", "pounds of food", "rescued from waste"),
    ("60,000+", "free food", "programs operating"),
    ("200+", "food banks", "in the network"),
    ("50", "states + PR", "reached nationwide"),

gap = 25

for i, (num, line1, line2) in enumerate(stats):
    col = i % 2
    row = i // 2
    x = 70 + col * (card_w + gap)

y += 2 * card_h + gap + 55

draw_text_centered(draw, "Every dollar provides at least 10 meals to neighbors in need", banner_top + 105, font_stat_context, TEXT_WHITE)

draw.line([(150, y), (W-150, y)], fill=ACCENT_ORANGE, width=2)
y += 45

# ===== CALLS TO ACTION =====
draw_text_centered(draw, "HOW YOU CAN HELP", y, font_section_title, TEXT_WHITE)
y += 65

cta_items = [
    ("DONATE", "Give now — every dollar provides 10 meals", ACCENT_ORANGE),
    ("ADVOCATE", "Urge lawmakers to support hunger relief", ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("FUNDRAISE", "Inspire your community to take action", ACCENT_LIGHT),
    ("VOLUNTEER", "Sort, pack, and distribute food", TEXT_WHITE),

for i, (title, desc, color) in enumerate(cta_items):
    cy = y + i * 85
    # Accent bar on left

    draw.text((100, cy+48), desc, font=font_cta_desc, fill=TEXT_MUTED)

y += 4 * 85 + 45

# Decorative line
draw.line([(150, y), (W-150, y)], fill=ACCENT_ORANGE, width=2)
y += 40

# ===== FOOTER VISION =====
font_vision = get_font(font_path_regular, 21)
vision_lines = [
    "Hunger touches every community. Together — through donations, advocacy,",
    "volunteering, and shared purpose — an America without hunger is within reach.",

for line in vision_lines:
    draw_text_centered(draw, line, y, font_vision, TEXT_MUTED)

y += 30

# ===== BRANDING =====
draw_text_centered(draw, "FEEDING AMERICA", y, font_brand, ACCENT_GOLD)

# Save high quality

print("Poster saved to /app/output/final_poster.png")
